data.title: Ethereum’s ‘Netflix Moment’ Could Send ETH To $10K By 2029 As Bitcoin Eyes $81K
data.description: Michaël Van de Poppe said that cryptocurrencies "haven't seen any moves at all," with SOL/BTC barely beginning to rise after Solana broke its 21-day moving average and flipped a level.
data.keywords: Netflix, Michaël van de Poppe, Ethereum, Bitcoin, Ted Pillows, Van de Poppe
